in_sanskrit.name: चैतुर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who subdues or conquers

in_marathi.name: Chaitu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chaitu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chaitu is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu god Ganesha. The name Chaitu signifies the god of wealth and prosperity. It is believed that invoking Chaitu's name brings abundance and good fortune. This name is also a tribute to the elephant-headed god who is revered for his wisdom and strength.
